description: Film a designed page so scrolling plays it like a 3D film: the camera ORBITS the hero subject (AI video from the photo itself, so people, styling and set stay the same), then flies into up to two later sections' photographs; each film is held full-screen while the scroll plays it, with depth on the text and sections tilting into place. Photos stay as the fallback (reduced motion, frames loading). Web pages only; paid (~80 coins for the hero + ~60 per scene transition, charged on the real video cost; transitions are skipped when the balance is short). Takes a few minutes. Use it when the user wants the site to feel cinematic or 'like the TikTok/Awwwards sites'. For a new design, pass cinematic_hero=true to sketchxflow_design_page instead.
name: sketchxflow_cinematic_hero
title: Film a page's hero into a scroll video
